newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Editorials - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK Newspaper Editorials - July 7.

text.p: These are highlights of comments in the Hong Kong press. The views expressed are those of the newspapers quoted and do not represent an editorial viewpoint of Reuters.

-- The HONG KONG ECONOMIC JOURNAL said Hong Kong was a successful showcase to the world, mostly because its people were open-minded. But if Beijing killed the values and beliefs in Hong Kong, the territory would be of no value to China. The paper said it would be dangerous if Hong Kong people started to trade their patriotism for commercial benefits -- If that happened, Hong Kong would be finished by the hands of its own people, not China's.

-- The Beijing-funded TA KUNG PAO said one way to show the support of the central and provincial governments to Hong Kong was non-interference. To implement the "one counry, two systems" policy, it was necessary for Hong Kong people to strengthen their knowledge and understanding of and cooperation with the mainland. The paper said to support did not mean interference, and autonomy did not mean development in isolation.

-- The English-language HONGKONG STANDARD said that to make a success of the "one country,two systems" concept, there must be a feeling of mutual trust between Beijing and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government. There must be increased communication between them, and that trust must not fall into complacency. Hong Kong's autonomy has been granted and we must not undermine it, the paper said.
